----------------
## Packages ##
----------------

```{r, message = FALSE}

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

```

--------------------------------------------
## Raw data & reference taxa list ##
--------------------------------------------

# ---------- Baiau Superior -----------

# Dataframes

```{r}

# Raw counts:
ba21_raw_counts <- read_excel("Select your directory/Raw_count_data/BA21_counts.xlsx")

# Reference taxa list:
ba21_taxa_reference <- read_excel("Select your directory/Raw_count_data/BA21_spp_reference.xlsx")

```

# Harmonisation

```{r}

# Merge both dataframes:
ba21_ID_merged <- merge(ba21_raw_counts, ba21_taxa_reference[, c("ID_count", "Species_ID")], 
                         by.x = "ID_count", 
                         by.y = "ID_count", 
                         all.x = TRUE) # Keep all columns of the first dataframe

# Summarise morphotypes:
ba21_counts <- ba21_ID_merged %>%
  group_by(ID_sample, sample, Species_ID) %>% 
  summarise(No = sum(No)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-ID_sample) %>% 
  mutate(sample = as.numeric(as.character(sample))) %>%
  arrange(sample)


```
